source.title: Open problems in singular integral theory

trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/205192 for document identifier 205192. Local workflow shard metadata identifies the exact work as 'Open problems in singular integral theory' (1993) with DOI 10.1216/jiea/1181075725.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged plus network_or_dns_failure. Direct local fetch of the zbMATH resolver returned an HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge, and later shell fetches to zbmath.org, api.zbmath.org, and candidate full-text hosts failed DNS resolution in the restricted environment. Browser/search access to the zbMATH API did not expose a readable full-text source.

Identifier-specific recovery used the DOI and exact title from local resolver metadata. Candidate Project Euclid, RMMC/ASU Journal of Integral Equations and Applications archive, MSP, DOI, and exact-title search paths were inspected or searched, but no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered.

No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML artifact was available. The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, local shard metadata, DOI metadata, citation pages, search snippets, or guessed archive paths.
No candidates were accepted because there were no verbatim problem-statement quotes with page numbers or stable HTML locators from a readable primary source.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-205192.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
